question: Can the scalar auxiliary priors |cos(L-hat, PAB_mean)| (regression) or polhode-topology binary class be recovered from LC features?
hypothesis: LC features carry usable scalar omega-direction information via |cos(L-hat,PAB)| or polhode-class, even though full L-hat direction (s055b) was unrecoverable.
narrative_md: Tested two scalar reductions of the unrecoverable L-hat direction: |cos(L-hat,PAB_mean)| regression and polhode-binary topology class. Both WEAK -- |cos| holdout RMSE 0.299 is WORSE than the cohort-mean baseline 0.285, and polhode-class best accuracy 0.80 is below the 0.85 majority baseline. Decisive negative: at the s008-style feature granularity the LC carries omega-MAGNITUDE info (pol_diam) but essentially no usable omega-DIRECTION info. Targets computed analytically from cached truth (q0, omega0, I) -- oracle-leak.
